scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:coverage && node --test skills/ghidra-coordinator/dist/tests/*.test.js && npm run test:release
scripts.test:acceptance: node scripts/run-automation.mjs test --suite acceptance --tag offline --property RestoreLockedMode=true
scripts.test:acceptance:native: node scripts/run-automation.mjs test --suite acceptance --tag native --tag facade --property RestoreLockedMode=true --timeout-seconds 2400
scripts.test:acceptance:full: node scripts/run-automation.mjs test --suite acceptance --tag native --tag full --property RestoreLockedMode=true --timeout-seconds 18000
